name: loopline
description: Automate the Jira → branch → commit → push → merge-request loop from inside VS Code.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Connect Jira and GitLab to see your active-sprint tickets and start branches in one click.
[Run Setup Wizard](command:loopline.runSetup)

Already set up? [Create a Branch](command:loopline.createBranch)

loopline.jira.type.markdownDescription: Jira hosting type. `cloud` uses email + API token (Basic auth); `server` uses a Personal Access Token (Bearer auth) for Jira Server / Data Center.

loopline.jira.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of your Jira instance, e.g. `https://your-company.atlassian.net` (Cloud) or `https://jira.your-company.com` (Server).

loopline.jira.email.markdownDescription: Your Atlassian account email. Only used for Jira **Cloud** (Basic auth). Leave blank for Server/DC.

loopline.gitlab.projectId.markdownDescription: Optional. Pin the GitLab project id or `namespace/path`. Leave blank to auto-detect from your `origin` remote.

loopline.defaultTargetBranch.description: Default target branch for merge requests.

loopline.branchTypeMapping.markdownDescription: Maps a Jira issue type to the branch prefix. e.g. `Bug` → `bugfix`, producing `bugfix/LPB-1234-...`.

loopline.commitTypeMapping.markdownDescription: Maps a **branch prefix** to the commit-message prefix. e.g. branch prefix `feature` → commit prefix `feat`, producing `feat: LPB-1234 ...`.

loopline.branchNameTemplate.markdownDescription: Template for generated branch names. Tokens: `{prefix}`, `{ticket}`, `{slug}`. Defaults to Loopline's original shape (`feature/LPB-1234-some-summary`); change only if your team's convention differs. Note: `Loopline: Commit, Push & Create MR` recovers the ticket/prefix from the current branch name assuming the default shape — a very different template may fall back to asking for the ticket key manually.

loopline.commitMessageTemplate.markdownDescription: Template for generated commit messages. Tokens: `{prefix}`, `{ticket}`, `{summary}`. Defaults to Loopline's original shape (`feat: LPB-1234 some summary`).

loopline.changelog.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt in to auto-drafting a CHANGELOG.md entry when an MR is created — one bullet under a `## Unreleased` section (created if missing), using the ticket key and your commit summary. Only acts if the project already has a CHANGELOG.md; never creates one. The entry is committed and pushed to the same branch as a small follow-up commit, so it lands on the MR you just opened.

loopline.changelog.categoryMapping.markdownDescription: Maps a **branch prefix** to the CHANGELOG.md subsection (`### Added` / `### Changed` / `### Fixed`, matching Keep a Changelog style) its entry is filed under. Unmapped prefixes default to `Changed`.

loopline.confirmBranchName.description: Show the generated branch name for confirmation/edit before creating it.

loopline.mr.includeJiraDescription.description: Include the Jira ticket description in the generated merge-request body.

loopline.protectedBranches.description: Branches Loopline warns you about before committing directly onto them.

loopline.jira.transitionOnBranch.markdownDescription: Optional. When a branch is created, move the ticket toward this status (e.g. `In Progress`). Matches the target status or transition name in your Jira workflow. Leave blank to disable.

loopline.jira.transitionOnMr.markdownDescription: Optional. When a merge request is created, move the ticket toward this status (e.g. `In Review`). Leave blank to disable.

enumDescriptions: Only your issues in the currently active sprint
loopline.jira.ticketScope.markdownDescription: Which of your assigned issues the **Loopline sidebar** and the *Create Branch* picker list. `activeSprint` uses `sprint in openSprints()` and automatically falls back to all-open on boards/projects without sprints. You can flip this any time with the filter button in the sidebar's title bar.

loopline.ai.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt in to AI-generated merge-request descriptions. When on, Loopline sends the branch **diff** and **ticket text** to the configured AI provider (`loopline.ai.provider`) to draft the MR body, which you review and edit before it's posted. Requires an API key (`Loopline: Set AI (Anthropic) API Key` or `Loopline: Set AI (OpenAI Gateway) API Key`).

enumDescriptions: Call the Anthropic Messages API directly (or a proxy in front of it)
Call an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, e.g. an internal AI gateway in front of Bedrock/Azure/etc.
loopline.ai.provider.markdownDescription: Which AI backend to use for `loopline.ai.model` / `loopline.ai.baseUrl`.

loopline.ai.model.markdownDescription: Model id used for AI features. For the `anthropic` provider this is an Anthropic model id (e.g. `claude-sonnet-5`); for the `openai` provider it's whatever id your gateway expects (e.g. `bedrock-claude-sonnet-4-5`).

loopline.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: AI API base URL. For the `anthropic` provider this defaults to the public Anthropic API; point it at your company proxy if source code can't go there directly. For the `openai` provider there is no default — set it to your gateway's base URL (e.g. `https://api-eu1.aigateway.example.com/v1`).

loopline.ai.maxDiffBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum diff size (in bytes) sent to the AI. Larger diffs are truncated and flagged in the prompt.

loopline.ai.checkDiffAgainstTicket.markdownDescription: Opt in to an AI check, run after staging and before the commit, that compares your diff against the ticket's summary/description and warns about anything the ticket mentions that the diff doesn't seem to address. You can always commit anyway. Requires `loopline.ai.enabled`.

loopline.showTicketDetailsOnBranch.markdownDescription: After creating a branch, open the ticket description in a window and (if AI is enabled) offer to generate implementation suggestions.

loopline.baseBranch.markdownDescription: Branch to base new branches on. Blank uses `loopline.defaultTargetBranch`.

enumDescriptions: Ask each time whether to fetch the base first
Always fetch the base and branch from it
Never fetch; branch from current HEAD
loopline.updateBaseBeforeBranch.markdownDescription: Whether to fetch the base branch from origin before creating a new branch, so you start from up-to-date code.

loopline.http.proxy.markdownDescription: Proxy URL for Jira/GitLab/AI requests, e.g. `http://proxy.corp.com:8080`. Overrides `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY`. **Node does not use the OS proxy**, so on corporate networks (especially Windows) the browser may work while Loopline can't connect — set this if so. `NO_PROXY` is respected. Run **Loopline: Diagnose Connection** to see what's being used.

loopline.http.extraCaCerts.markdownDescription: Absolute paths to extra CA certificate files (PEM/`.crt`) to trust. **Node does not use the Windows certificate store**, so a self-hosted Jira/GitLab behind a corporate CA or an HTTPS-inspecting proxy fails with `UNABLE_TO_VERIFY_LEAF_SIGNATURE` until the root CA is added here (or via `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS`).

loopline.http.allowInsecureTls.markdownDescription: ⚠️ Disable TLS certificate verification for Loopline's requests. **Insecure** — it defeats HTTPS protection and exposes your tokens to interception. Use only as a temporary workaround; prefer `loopline.http.extraCaCerts`.

enumDescriptions: If anything is already staged, commit exactly that (preserves `git add -p` hunk staging). Otherwise stage tracked modifications, asking before including untracked files.
Always choose the files to commit from a list.
Stage everything, including untracked files (`git add -A`).
loopline.staging.markdownDescription: What *Commit, Push & Create MR* stages. `respectStaged` treats your index as your intent: if you've staged files (or hunks via `git add -p`), only those are committed. `all` is the old `git add -A` behavior, which sweeps in unrelated edits and untracked files.

enumDescriptions: Keep the merge request at a single commit by squashing the branch's commits (force-pushed with --force-with-lease). You are asked before any history is rewritten.
Add a new commit each time; the merge request accumulates commits.
loopline.singleCommit.markdownDescription: Keep the merge request to **one commit**. With `squash`, re-running the commit command on a branch that already has commits offers to collapse them into a single commit and force-push with `--force-with-lease` (which fails safely if someone else pushed). The first commit on a branch never needs squashing.

loopline.sidebar.groupByStatus.markdownDescription: Group tickets in the Loopline sidebar under their Jira status (In Progress, To Do, …). Grouping is skipped automatically when every ticket shares one status.

loopline.sidebar.colorfulIcons.markdownDescription: Tint each ticket's icon by issue type (Bug red, Story green, Epic purple, Sub-task orange, Task/other blue) instead of the plain theme-foreground icon.

loopline.impact.minutesPerBranch.markdownDescription: Minutes assumed saved per branch Loopline creates for you, used only for the estimate in the sidebar's Impact row.

loopline.impact.minutesPerCommit.markdownDescription: Minutes assumed saved per commit + push Loopline handles, used only for the estimate in the sidebar's Impact row.

loopline.impact.minutesPerMr.markdownDescription: Minutes assumed saved per merge request Loopline creates, used only for the estimate in the sidebar's Impact row.

scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run bundle -- --production && vsce package
